I guess it would make sense to initialize StringInfo *out if we leave the function here.

changed this line in [version 3 of the diff](/wireshark/wireshark/-/merge_requests/7832/diffs?diff_id=465657722&start_sha=47df3aa7471f6738b5cd6d686167727e9d745bd0#1ff8c471c1b41c17b37c038fcc49826ee6e327db_3432_3431)

After checking the use of tls_hash(), I think we should return an error so that the parent function (tls_prf() or tls12_pfr()) reports the failure.
By doing so, intializing out is unnecessary but we must ensure the caller frees the memory before returning the failure.
